authentication_url.description: If include_authentication_url was true in the request object then this object is populated.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the request was create at

id.description: Unique ID to identify mandates provided by Digio.

mandate_id.description: Unique ID to identify mandates provided by Digio.

state.description: This depicts the current state of mandate

type.description: The type for mandate which was requested

amendment_reason.description:
Reason for amendment
A001: On Customer Request
M036: Represent with CBS account number

collection_amount.description:
This is for fixed amount mandate EMI amount eg: 5500.50
Note: Mandate amount limit is 1,00,00,000 for physical/API/Esign mandate variant as per Circular No. NACH/2023-24/NACH/003 w.e.f. 15 Sep, 2023
Either of collection_amount or maximum_amount is mandatory

final_collection_date.description:
Date for Last Debit in yyyy-mm-dd
Maximum allowed limit for final_collection_date is 40 yrs .

Note: If Final collection date is not passed then DIGIO will set this to default 40 yrs

first_collection_date.description: Date for First Debit in yyyy-mm-dd ; means the date from which you want the mandate to be registered

frequency.description:
If is_recurring : true, pass debit frequency.
Note: Choose one from below, commensurate with your use case category (management category) eg: L001 (Loan Installment should have a defined frequency that is commensurate with the EMI schedule agreed upon with the customer eg: Monthly). Incorrect frequency passed for a management category, may lead to mandate registration failure and is at the destination bank's discretion.

maximum_amount.description:
Maximum amount that may be collected from the customer's account, per instruction eg: 5500.50
Note: Mandate amount limit is 1,00,00,000 for physical/API/Esign mandate variant as per Circular No. NACH/2023-24/NACH/003 w.e.f. 15 Sep, 2023
Either of collection_amount or maximum_amount is mandatory

ExternalSubUserSchema_Client.description: Sub user details, if the request was containing sub-user identifier.

details.description: Details about the exception. Usually contains the exception id for reference.

corporate_config_id.description:
Corporate profile created from dashboard has below info and is auto populated during user authentication.
Utility Code
Service provider name
Sponsor bank name
Sponsor bank
Sponsor bank ifsc

expire_in_days.description: Please pass this value to allow the end user to be able to submit the mandate image (in case of physical mandate) or perform eSign authentication within ‘X’ days. X you can pass as the value.

include_authentication_url.description: Pass True if authentication link is required in response payload based on above customer’s identifier

mandate_type.description: Type of mandate to be created

notify_customer.description: Set true to send notification to customer with a gateway link to authenticate/sign the mandate. Else, false

sub_user_identifier.description: If mandate needs to be reflected to specific sub-user

service_provider_utility_code.description: Utility code for the given corporate config
